name: Rincón de la Victoria (Spain)
description: Vertically divided golden yellow and navy blue, the yellow charged with the crowned municipal arms of Rincón de la Victoria between four blue stars, and the blue with three white horizontal stripes.
history: The official symbols of Rincón de la Victoria are its flag and its arms; the arms were approved by the Junta de Andalucía on 2 July 2004 and the flag on 24 February 2005. The flag is rectangular in the proportion 3 by 2, divided into two vertical stripes of equal width, golden yellow at the hoist and navy blue at the fly, the blue stripe bearing three white stripes of one ninth of the height.
